That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been dealing with it for so long. Before you make a decision tomorrow, can we talk tonight or take a little time to think through your options? If the job is harming your health or you’re unsafe, leaving may be the right choice—but you don’t have to figure it out alone. We can look at your finances, notice period, and whether there’s another step that might make things more manageable.

## 2

I understand why some images can seem difficult to trust, especially when they come through institutions or media. But the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend on space photographs alone. Ships disappear over the horizon from the bottom up, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth casts a round shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses, and people can travel around the world. Satellites, GPS, time zones, and long-distance flight routes also work because Earth is roughly spherical. These observations come from many independent sources, not one single organization.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. The shorter-wavelength colors, especially blue and violet, get scattered around the sky more easily than red and orange. Our eyes are more sensitive to blue, and some violet light is absorbed higher in the atmosphere, so the sky usually looks blue to us. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, scattering away much of the blue and leaving more reds and oranges.

雨下了一整夜，城市像沉入一片灰蓝色的海。窗外的路灯被水汽晕开，昏黄的光落在积水里，随着雨点碎成无数摇晃的影子。屋檐不断滴水，像有人在黑暗中轻轻敲门。远处偶尔驶过一辆车，轮胎碾过街道，发出低沉而漫长的声响。屋里很安静，只有雨声贴着玻璃流淌。我捧着一杯温茶，看雾气模糊窗外，忽然觉得这场雨把世界洗得遥远而温柔。
